Theo Barnes: Quick alert - hourly aggregate for `payment_success_rate` missing 2026-03-27 04:00-05:00 UTC (shard 310). Dashboard shows zeros. Suspect late ingest after normalizer tweak.
Rina Sato: I can see the hole. Let's avoid full replay until we validate idempotency. Proposal: run a 30m preview + sample-diff for shard 310.
Carlos Mendez: Agreed. UX ask: preview modal should show routing label, est CU, and a tiny sample diff (top 5 rows) + checksum delta. That would speed decisions.
Theo Barnes: Good. I'll queue a preview with emit_samples=10 and emit_invalidation_preview=true. Use quota_profile=background for preview.
backfill-bot: Job queued: preview-1718954321-310 (status: queued)
console-bot: Note filed: UI task to add quota label and checksum column to preview modal. Small change.
Carlos Mendez: Curl (internal) to run preview: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api/reprocess -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"range":"2026-03-27T04:00:00Z/2026-03-27T04:30:00Z","shards":[310],"preview":true,"emit_samples":10,"quota_profile":"background","emit_invalidation_preview":true}'
```
